candidates.user_message:
Liquidation-reserve remainder is refunded to a defaulting trader when a SHORT price loss is written off
On liquidation, the charge is max(notional * bountyBps, minBounty) capped at the reserve. For a SHORT on an inverse product whose price collapses, the liquidation notional collapses too, so the charge shrinks to minBounty while the price loss exceeds pledge+claim and is written off against LPs. The settlement plan then always unlocks the reserve remainder (reserve - minBounty) back to the liquidated account as withdrawable settlement, with no condition that write-off == 0. The reserve bucket is isolated from price PnL, and no code path offsets the remainder against the written-off bad debt.

candidates.user_message:
Second recapitalisation after a high-water-mark reset is misrouted to unassignedAssets instead of restoring senior principal
absorbLoss deliberately does not lower the senior high-water mark (HWM) at wipeout, because the HWM is the senior recovery entitlement. In the preview library, the bootstrap branch (senior==0 && junior==0) assigns seniorHighWaterMark = max(target, amount) absolutely, so a first small recap resets the HWM; the else branch only restores up to gap = HWM - seniorPrincipal, which is then 0, so a second recap is routed entirely to unassignedAssets and stops restoring senior principal. unassignedAssets > 0 also blocks all tranche deposits until the owner assigns it manually.
